versions.changelog:
Version 1.3.0 – Enhanced crypto monitoring and alert features

- Added support for real-time price monitoring and custom price alerts for BTC, ETH, SOL, and Meme coins.
- Now generates daily market reports and allows one-click access to key on-chain data.
- Improved alert validation (target price, conditions, interval) and introduced alert ID confirmation.
- Prioritizes Binance API data, automatically switching to CoinGecko or CoinCap if needed.
- Strictly monitoring and alerts only—no trading, wallet, or DeFi operations; information is not investment advice.
